Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator first erred by specifying the wrong local file path (/Users/user_name/... instead of the verified /Users/icyfeather/...), then continued to misdirect the workflow (pushing repeated browsing rather than parsing the JSON-LD or using the ORCID API) and ultimately prematurely declared failure. This misguidance prevented collecting the needed pre-2020 counts and led to the incorrect final (non-)answer instead of computing the correct 26.4.
